text: Inside, two elderly brothers sat at breakfast, and I later learned that they had made a strange bet two days before. <break time="0.8s" /> Once the Bank of England had printed two notes of a million pounds each, and one of them still lay in the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> The brothers wondered what would happen to an honest stranger with nothing in the world but that one huge note. <break time="0.8s" /> Brother A said that such a man would starve, because he would be arrested the moment he tried to change the note at a bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Brother B disagreed, and he bet twenty thousand pounds that the man would live thirty days on it and stay out of jail. <break time="0.8s" /> The two brothers sat at the window all day, watching for the right man, and at last I came along. <break time="0.8s" /> After asking me a few questions about myself, they handed me an envelope and said that I would find the explanation inside. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as I was out of sight of the house, I opened the envelope, and I saw that it contained money. <break time="0.8s" /> Without looking at it closely, I hurried to the nearest cheap eating house and ate until I could not hold any more. <break time="0.8s" /> When I finally took out the bill to pay, I almost fainted, for it was a note for a million pounds.
